public_rationale: AI restrictions were a disputed issue: the WGA records their rejection, and contemporary reporting identifies AI as part of the conflict. But Zitron also attributes a clear objective to executives. The AMPTP offered a different explanation, and the examined records do not establish which motive drove its position. Calling the whole claim supported would equate rejecting restrictions with proving the attributed intention.
limitations: Both bargaining parties had an interest in how their positions were presented.
A narrower claim that AI restrictions were disputed would be supported.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The WGA strike happened in part because entertainment executives clearly want to use AI to write content.

statement.excerpt: The strike has already cost the entertainment industry billions of dollars of losses in share value, and all because the AMPTP has decided that streaming content isn’t as valuable as television or film (despite taking just as much effort), and because entertainment’s elites very clearly want to be able to use artificial intelligence to write content.

from_speaker: because entertainment’s elites very clearly want to be able to use artificial intelligence to write content
While I am assuming a great deal about their motives
our_interpretation: Assess the supplied proposition about a cause of the strike, not the separate assertion about share-value losses.
The claim requires both a material dispute over AI writing and evidence that executives sought that capability. Rejection of restrictions is relevant but does not uniquely establish their motives.
Use May 1–12, 2023: the negotiating positions immediately before the strike and the situation described at publication.
criteria.support_condition: Negotiation records establish that executives' desire to retain AI writing capabilities materially contributed to the failure to reach an agreement and the resulting strike.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable records establish that AI writing was not a material disputed issue, or that the attributed executive objective was materially mistaken.
